description: The >>DISPLAY { arithmetic-expression | boolean-expression | literal | PARAMETER compilation-variable-name }... [UPON { compile-time-device ... | LISTING }] compiler directive (ISO §2023:7.3.12) - a COBOL-2023 addition: Annex E.3.3 item 16 ('The DISPLAY directive allows the display of compile-time information during the compilation of COBOL source') and Annex E.2 item 5, which lists DISPLAY among the compiler-directive words added in 2023. §2023:7.3.12.1 makes the destination the source listing or an implementor-defined compile-time device; WiseOwl COBOL produces no listing, so (§2023:7.3.12.4 GR2, DOC-A.1-53 to DOC-A.1-55) each operand is evaluated by the shared compile-time evaluator - or, for PARAMETER, read from the environment - and the operands of one directive are written as ONE line to the compiler's standard output (UPON SYSERR: standard error), at compile time, by the conditional-compilation driver. The introduction gate rejects the directive word below 2023.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.12; Annex E.2 item 5 + Annex E.3.3 item 16 (compiler-directive words added in 2023)

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.12.2 general format: the operand braces are not bracketed, so at least one operand is written (checked centrally as COBOL1911). The operands themselves - arithmetic-expression-1, boolean-expression-1, literal-1, PARAMETER compilation-variable-name-1, repeated, then the UPON phrase - are parsed by the directive-expression grammar and evaluated by the conditional-compilation driver, which diagnoses them as COBOL1619 and the UPON phrase as COBOL2698.

source:
>>DISPLAY "PB725"
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725DS.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.
